description: This file defines a class OrleansDefaultHasher that implements the IHasher interface. The class provides a default hashing mechanism based on Orleans' StableHash for grain placement. It includes a property Description and a method Hash that computes a hash value from a byte array.

classes.name: OrleansDefaultHasher
classes.description: Implements a default hashing mechanism for Orleans grain placement, using the StableHash.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a description string of the hash function used.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes and returns an integer hash value for the provided byte array.
